title: Component Spec
description: The build contract for one component (ADR-027): what it must be, read by the builder moments (/component-scaffold, /review-component). Selection and composition guidance stays in <Name>.metadata.json, which /layout-generation reads. scripts/validate-spec.js checks every spec against the schema, its metadata, its props type and its CSS Module.

component.description: Component name; must match the folder and metadata component.name.

anatomy.description: Every named part, top to bottom, including internal elements that are not ADR-023 parts. Names follow the ADR-023 naming contract (they are the Figma layer names).

element.description: Rendered HTML element, 'text' for a bare text node, or the library component it renders.

builtOn.description: Library component this part renders, when it renders one.

role.description: Semantic role as exposed to assistive technology, or 'presentation' when hidden from it. An authored fact: design files cannot carry it.

action.description: What activating this part does. Interactive parts only.

when.description: Condition under which an optional part renders, in prop terms.

props.description: The approved API proposal (ADR-026), kept. Every prop the component declares itself must appear; native attributes appear only when the contract depends on them.

options.description: variantAxis and lifecycle props: the allowed values. Must equal the TypeScript union and the metadata axis.

default.description: Default value; null when the prop is off unless set.

concept.description: Row of the ADR-026 prop vocabulary, 'native', or 'new term: <reason>'.

property.description: Figma property name. Differs from code only by casing or an ADR-026 recorded mapping.

set.description: Figma component set, when not the component's main set.

constraints.description: Prop combinations the component requires or forbids. Contextual misuse (where a component is placed) stays in metadata usage.antiPatterns.

if.description: Prop → value that triggers the rule; '*' means any value is set.

ignore.description: Props that have no effect while the rule applies.

enforcedBy.description: What stops a violation. Empty means documented only: the validator reports it as a backlog item.

states.description: Every state, tagged with its ADR-025 kind. appData = the ADR-025 exception (interaction state held as a prop).

trigger.description: CSS pseudo-class for interaction states; the prop and value otherwise.

styles.description: Part → ordered rules. Each rule sets CSS properties under a condition; later rules win. A value is a token path, a literal with a reason, or a reference to another property's value.

when.description: Prop → value, plus optional 'state' naming an entry in states. Empty object = always.

divergences.description: Known Figma ↔ code differences and the decision on each.

sameAs.description: Another CSS property of the same part.
